notes: Sepolia rehearsal, chain id 11155111. SOVRN.ONE (nine ASCII characters, one full stop) / SVO has 18 decimals and a fixed 1,000,000,000 supply minted to its deployer. Native ETH is currency0; SVO is currency1. Initial sqrtPriceX96 792281625142643375935439503360000 means 100,000,000 SVO per ETH and a 10 ETH opening cap. The pool LP fee is 12500 (1.25%), additional to hook fees; tick spacing is 60. These are technical descriptions; chain selection, allocations and deployment policy are controlled separately. SovrnHook takes manager, token and factory in the declared flat order, with no owner argument. Its five permissions encode 8396 (0x20cc); all others are false. Callbacks are PoolManager-only. Only the supplied factory may initialize its single native ETH/SVO pool through the manager; second initialization and wrong pool keys are rejected. The hook constructor deploys the immutable LifeForceVault, discoverable through vault(), with no separate manifest entry. Sells pay 3.5% in ETH. Buy fees decay linearly from 50% through 26.75% to 3.5% at elapsed 0/1800/3600 seconds after initialization. The base quote mechanism, four exact-input/output modes and partial-fill fee handling are retained. All hook fees go directly to the vault when manager ETH covers the fee; otherwise the hook records one native ERC-6909 claim counter. Anyone may redeemFees() after settlement to pay the entire counter to the vault; failed redemption rolls back for retry. The vault assigns floor(receipt * 3000 / 10000) to buybackReserve and the remainder to inferenceReserve (BUYBACK_BPS 3000, INFERENCE_BPS 7000). Reserve views include forced ETH, so their sum equals its ETH balance. Only REFUEL_SAFE 0xb1eC9d1C36974d05eb9889eBf8A150b05791E559 may withdrawInference(amount) or withdrawBuyback(amount), each within its matching reserve and only to itself. Both withdrawals share a reentrancy guard and revert if payment fails. The Safe can withdraw both reserves; spending on voice AI inference and manual buybacks is an operator responsibility. The vault never swaps. Anyone may fund it or burn() its entire SVO balance to DEAD; zero balance reverts. Burning increments totalBurned without reducing totalSupply. Holders get no payouts. There are no owners, setters, further minting, pause, blacklist or upgrade powers. Use PrepareLaunch to mine the new initcode for flags 8396; it has no environment reads or broadcasts. The factory must deploy, initialize and seed liquidity atomically to protect the opening price. Hook fees apply only to poolKey(); other pools are unrestricted. Send voluntary funding to the vault: unsolicited ETH or claims sent to the hook may be stranded. A rejecting Safe blocks withdrawals only. A rejecting fee destination would revert direct fee swaps and claim redemption, but not claim minting. Live Safe control and ETH reception remain unverified. The seven imported findings do not reproduce in the accepted tree: 7f399222d173 collection dependency removed; 97c5c734540c team payments removed; 62d4c4fd4953 exact token identity present; a22971544a0d NFT/distributor/auction paths removed; e6f4ad884062 manifest already names Sovrn contracts; 1332d2af4454 preparation uses SovrnHook initcode and SOVRN_FLAGS; 42d58e13b8bc README has the required identity, numbers, privileges and base credit. Existing regression tests use a real vendored v4 PoolManager deployed locally. This assignment changes only this manifest. The existing launch-attestation.json must be regenerated for the edited manifest by the attestation stage. That record also has a pre-existing hash mismatch for test/AdversarialFees.t.sol.
